## Fonts (not bundled)

The web app loads typefaces at runtime from Google Fonts (https://fonts.google.com/),
one family at a time and only for the faces the current composition actually uses.
They are not included in this repository, and are distributed by their authors
under the SIL Open Font License 1.1:

Dela Gothic One
DotGothic16
IBM Plex Mono
LXGW WenKai TC
Liu Jian Mao Cao
Long Cang
M PLUS Rounded 1c
Ma Shan Zheng
Noto Sans SC
Noto Serif SC
ZCOOL KuaiLe
ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou
ZCOOL XiaoWei
Zhi Mang Xing
